items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: How about Wes Helvey's band, along with Buddy Lee and you say Edgar Curran. Those are some of the musicians who played with you in Wes Helvey's band?

ctx.x: ... I played trombone too and I played trombone in Fletcher Henderson's band, Samuel Williams.
How about Wes Helvey's band, along with Buddy Lee and you say Edgar Curran. Those are some of the musicians who played with you in Wes Helvey's band? How big was the band?
... I think about seven, (Vince) on piano.
